title: Tenant Model Route
description: One routing row that maps a (tenant_id, project_id, task_shape) tuple to a primary model + fallback chain + hosting layer + caching policy. The GAD Gateway resolves an inbound request to exactly one of these rows. Ties to `data/registry/teachers.json` (task_shape vocabulary) and `data/registry/model_families.json` (model id space). Decisions: slm-learning-218 (paid evolutions subsidize cheap daily inference), slm-learning-219 (customer souls are adapters, not separate models), slm-learning-220 (dedicated GPU requires proven utilization), slm-learning-168 (hybrid runtime), slm-learning-197 (teacher policy).

tenant_id.description: Customer / org id. 'shared' for tenant-agnostic public routes.

project_id.description: Project / workspace id within the tenant. Optional — null when the route is tenant-wide.

task_shape.description: Task category. SHOULD match a value in data/registry/teachers.json::policies[].task_shape (code_function_completion, code_repair, tool_action_json, math_reasoning, trajectory_completion, bulk_paraphrase, chain_of_thought_synth, frontier_judge_panel, logit_inspection, ...) or be a tenant-private extension prefixed with 'custom:'.

tier.description: Pricing tier the route is provisioned for. Drives layer eligibility and SLA.

primary_adapter_id.description: Optional LoRA / adapter delta_id to compose with the base. Format follows Delta Graph (slm-learning-100). Null for bare-base routes.

shared_skill_adapters.description: Shared GAD skill adapter delta_ids stacked on top of the base. Loaded from the multi-LoRA pool.

vertical_adapter_id.description: Optional vertical adapter (game / marketing / code / writing) delta_id.

customer_soul_adapter_id.description: Optional customer/project soul adapter id; references customer_soul_adapter.adapter_id.

hardware_class.description: Required GPU class when hosting_layer is B or C. 'api_only' when Layer A.

fallback_policy.description: Escalation chain when the primary route fails or under-performs. Models are registry ids; aligns with teacher policy fallback_chain (slm-learning-197).

fallback_chain.description: Ordered list of model_ids to try when primary fails.

kv_cache_share_with_tenants.description: Tenant ids permitted to share KV cache. Default empty (full isolation).

billing.description: Cost accounting hooks. Numbers stamped into per-request telemetry.

metrics.description: Rolling KPI snapshot. Populated by telemetry; this schema declares the slot.

promotion_eligibility.description: Layer A → B → C promotion gating per slm-learning-220.

consent_mode.description: How tenant traffic + outputs may flow back into shared improvements. Mirrors customer_soul_adapter.consent_mode.
